general_information.Syllabus Name: Data mining with Tensorflow_Khai phá dữ liệu với Tensorflow

general_information.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: * Understand Data Mining concepts and techniques, such as information extraction, ranking and search, online advertising, opinion mining, social network analysis, etc. * Aware of the important role of domain experts in data mining. * Be able to choose or design appropriate models to solve Data Mining problems, and be able to proceed with the chosen/designed approach, avoiding common mistakes in conducting data mining projects, and reach the high quality knowledge from data.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all presentations and projects/problems assigned by instructor and submit on time. - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information.
general_information.Note: Progress assessment: 1) 04 Labs 30% 2) 01 Project: 40% FE: Final Exam: 30% Completion Criteria: - Every component of progress assessment must be > 0. - Final Result >=5 & Final Exam Score >=4

description: * Understand Data Mining concepts and techniques, such as information extraction, ranking and search, online advertising, opinion mining, social network analysis, etc. * Aware of the important role of domain experts in data mining. * Be able to choose or design appropriate models to solve Data Mining problems, and be able to proceed with the chosen/designed approach, avoiding common mistakes in conducting data mining projects, and reach the high quality knowledge from data.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Knowledge in the field of multidisciplinary data mining.
Knowledge of the general data features.
Knowledge in techniques for data preprocessing
Knowledge of data warehouses, OLAP (online analytical processing), and data cube technology.
Use methods for mining frequent patterns, associations, and correlations in large data sets with TensorFlow 2.0.
Knowledge and ability to apply methods for data classification in TensorFlow 2.0.
Knowledge and ability to apply methods for Cluster analysis in TensorFlow 2.0.
Knowledge trends, applications, and research frontiers in data mining.

assessments.Duration: Whole course, from day one to last day
assessments.No Question: A list of questions for each project, which show the problem to be solved by the project
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Contain as much as possible all aspects of the course
assessments.Grading Guide: The class is divided into 10 groups, each work on a project
